# gramlot-js-server 0.3.24

Aligns Node/Bun hosting, Browser/Worker export and project creation with the common core and gallery release. Environments provide the included collections to Page classes; external rendering and editor engines remain lazy.

The Python/Kajenn JSONL database experiment is not implemented by the JavaScript host or Worker exporter. Offline examples retain their existing server-feature restrictions. Invoice application and Python compiled-page export are excluded.
